LanguageData.CC_Settings_FaithTurretsHere: A faith against turrets minds only the turrets where they are
LanguageData.CC_Settings_FaithTurretsHere_Tip: With an ideology that scorns automated turrets: the game gives its mood to everyone while the colony owns such a turret anywhere, on another home or in a hatch's dungeon below the home whose turrets a hacked terminal handed over. With this on, the mood comes only to someone on a map where the colony has an automated turret. A turret someone has to man, such as a mortar, doesn't count. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_FaithTurretsHere: A faith against turrets minds only the map where the turrets stand.
